findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0392: References to Enforced Updating APIs
findings.explanation:
No Play In-App Updates API and no backend minimum-version check. BuildConfig.VERSION_NAME is only exposed to the help page, and startup goes straight to session restore.
app/src/main/java/app/pennyjar/MainActivity.kt:64: Startup navigation picks Login/Locked/home with no update-enforcement check first.

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0272: Identify Dependencies with Known Vulnerabilities in the Android Project
findings.explanation:
10 of the declared dependencies with exact versions match no OSV advisory, but 2 declarations have no version Ward can read (see evidence). Check those, and transitive dependencies, with a Gradle-aware scanner. OSV Maven data downloaded 2026-11-25T19:34:24.991Z (published Mon, 23 Nov 2026 21:33:52 GMT).
app/build.gradle.kts:44: androidx.compose.ui:ui: no version (a BOM or constraint may set it)
app/build.gradle.kts:45: androidx.compose.material3:material3: no version (a BOM or constraint may set it)

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0338: References to Storage Integrity Check APIs
findings.explanation:
The biometric_unlock boolean is read from plain SharedPreferences with no HMAC or signature, and it alone decides whether MainActivity shows the Locked screen. Flipping it to false skips the biometric lock.
app/src/main/java/app/pennyjar/settings/SettingsStore.kt:10: Biometric-lock flag read from SharedPreferences without integrity verification.
app/src/main/java/app/pennyjar/MainActivity.kt:66: The unverified flag decides whether the app is locked behind biometrics.

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0242: Missing Certificate Pinning in Network Security Configuration
findings.explanation:
The NSC has no pin-set for any domain, and neither OkHttpClient sets a CertificatePinner, so API, upload, image and help hosts are unpinned (relevant for MASVS-NETWORK-2 / L2).
app/src/main/res/xml/network_security_config.xml:3: base-config trusts system CAs with no pin-set and there's no domain-config with pins.

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0258: References to Keyboard Caching Attributes in UI Elements
findings.explanation:
The password uses OutlinedSecureTextField, but the 'Private note' field (which the app encrypts at rest with a Keystore key, so treats as sensitive) is a plain OutlinedTextField with the default caching/autocorrecting keyboard.
app/src/main/java/app/pennyjar/ui/AddExpenseScreen.kt:116: Private note field uses a plain OutlinedTextField with no non-caching KeyboardOptions (autoCorrect off / password type).

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0291: References to Screen Capturing Prevention APIs
findings.explanation:
No FLAG_SECURE (or any screen-capture prevention) anywhere, yet MainActivity shows financial data: expenses, amounts, places and decrypted private notes.
app/src/main/java/app/pennyjar/MainActivity.kt:43: MainActivity sets its content without ever setting WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_SECURE on the window.

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0340: References to Overlay Attack Protections
findings.explanation:
The login screen and settings (biometric unlock, delete account) have no filterTouchesWhenObscured, onFilterTouchEventForSecurity, obscured-flag checks or setHideOverlayWindows, though the app targets API 36.
app/src/main/java/app/pennyjar/auth/LoginScreen.kt:78: Sign-in button submitting credentials has no overlay/tapjacking protection.

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0318: References to SDK APIs Known to Handle Sensitive User Data
findings.explanation:
The app passes user data to the Mixpanel SDK: identify(userId) on sign-in, plus expense_added events with category, amount band and has_place. Tracking is opt-out by default and consent-gated, but the data still reaches a third-party SDK and must be declared.
app/src/main/java/app/pennyjar/analytics/Analytics.kt:14: Server user ID sent to Mixpanel via identify().
app/src/main/java/app/pennyjar/analytics/Analytics.kt:24: Expense category and amount band sent to Mixpanel.

findings.title: MASWE-0072: Inadequate Privacy Policy
findings.explanation:
A privacy policy link or text is in the app. Ward doesn't read the policy: check that it matches what the app collects and the Data safety answers.
app/src/main/java/app/pennyjar/settings/SettingsScreen.kt:42: privacy policy
app/src/main/java/app/pennyjar/settings/SettingsScreen.kt:91: privacy policy
app/src/main/java/app/pennyjar/settings/SettingsScreen.kt:93: privacy policy

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0324: References to Root Detection Mechanisms
findings.explanation:
No root detection anywhere: no su/Magisk path checks, build-tag checks, root-detection library or Play Integrity call.
app/src/main/java/app/pennyjar/PennyJarApp.kt:42: Application startup sets up auth, sync and analytics without any root/environment check.

findings.title: MASTG-TEST-0352: References to Debugging Detection APIs
findings.explanation:
No debugger detection: no Debug.isDebuggerConnected, TracerPid or ptrace checks in the Kotlin code, and no native code.
app/src/main/java/app/pennyjar/PennyJarApp.kt:42: Application startup runs no debugger-detection check.
